title: Bittensor Daily News: November 8, 2026
summary: TrajectoryRL merges a default-on miner-share burn mode; Zils tightens customer-model delivery gates. Plus 404-GEN deployment requirements, Leadpoet and Reliquary operator fixes, THOR’s finalized owner change and qualifying Vanta and Ormas burns. Code changes, operational plans and executed transactions are kept distinct.

updates.headline: SN8 Vanta records four qualifying alpha burns on November 8
updates.summary: Four successful direct burn_alpha calls on November 8 each individually exceed the 100-alpha threshold: 125 alpha at 06:39:00 UTC, 166.666666666 alpha at 09:45:36 UTC, 187.5 alpha at 16:18:24 UTC and 199.847267161 alpha at 17:19:00 UTC. The later executions are finalized blocks 9,462,584 (extrinsic 27, event 266) and 9,462,886 (extrinsic 8, event 180). Each signed request matches its event amount. All four come from a wallet different from Vanta’s registered owner, so they count toward all-wallet subnet burns, not owner-wallet burns. Vanta’s registration 1,477,264 is unchanged. The earlier two events remain in the archive without recounting; purchase, buyback or revenue funding is not inferred.

updates.headline: SN11 TrajectoryRL merges a default-on miner-share burn mode
updates.summary: The November 8 merge of PR347 adds BURN_ALL, enabled by default in version 0.7.8, and routes weight ticks through the existing burn helper instead of the seated winner. The intended denominator is 100% of the miner share, not all subnet emissions; the team describes owner and validator shares as unaffected. Setting BURN_ALL=0 restores the normal path. This is verified merged code and a stated direction for validators. Production rollout, the live RecycleOrBurn setting and actual emission withholding were not independently verified. It is not an executed transaction burn or a new five-slot eTAO allocation event.

updates.headline: SN17 404-GEN changes Pod authentication and bounds final-save rendering
updates.summary: November 7–8 source changes replace cached Pod bearer grants with allocation-bound signed-hotkey authentication and fixed round deadlines. The documented SDK is 0.2.19; matching gateway and Pod images are required, and existing grant-dependent Pods need replacement. Follow-ups deduplicate reconnects, separate read-only ownership lookup from lifecycle mutations, and retain the last completed ownership result during a delayed poll while still fencing explicit ownership loss. A November 8 13:03 UTC commit gives final-save rendering batches 150 seconds, retains 30-second previews and returns HTTP504 render_timeout for retry rather than validation rejection. Documentation requires witness client 0.2.19 and renderer client 0.1.5 or compatible later versions. No production artifacts were built or deployed by that commit; code does not prove the separately reported gateway incident has recovered.
updates.ratingReason: Concrete miner and operator compatibility requirements, consolidated across reliability fixes. Live rollout, recovery and team test results were not independently reproduced.

updates.headline: SN71 Leadpoet consolidates Arena evidence, routing and restart safeguards
updates.summary: November 7–8 merges tighten listed-parent public-company evidence, preserve sanitized private upstream evidence separately from worker-visible content, and retain blank provider plaintext without awarding thinking credit. Prospective admission can explicitly bind an approved Kimi alternate; older markerless clients retain Sol and the ordinary DeepSeek primary remains unchanged. Incomplete guarded restarts invoke rollback, retries reuse verified evidence, and ampersand company LinkedIn slugs are normalized while encoded namespaces, separators and double-encoding remain rejected. Frozen scoring outcomes are preserved. Live schema, image and gateway release gates remain; no production migration, repaired round, training readiness or customer adoption is independently established.
updates.ratingReason: Bounded evidence fidelity and failure-handling consequences for operators, with no independently verified production outcome or broad security/accuracy claim.

updates.headline: SN81 Reliquary fixes order-audit exposure and drand warm-up
updates.summary: November 8 PR471 values the work a charged failure can actually forfeit within its own settlement period, including the prompt/output price ratio. New generation orders default to a 30-minute hold instead of 72 minutes. Charged-failure and short-completion limits remain, and the existing corpus-validator rule is unchanged. PR470 moves drand initialization before auditing each order to avoid fallback over-auditing. These merged implementation fixes do not independently establish rollout, measured customer savings or the economic guarantees described by the team.
updates.ratingReason: Useful operator settlement and reliability fixes; production activation, actual costs and team tests were not independently reproduced.

updates.headline: SN127 Zils requires every customer question family to pass before model delivery
updates.summary: PR218, merged November 8 at 03:34 UTC, replaces pooled acceptance with per-question-family accuracy and baseline Brier-improvement gates. A strong decision family can no longer hide a weak one; failed families are named. Migration retains per-decision no-regression, while single-decision and legacy unscored rows preserve prior behavior. Separately, November 7 PR217 updates miner terms for mainnet SN127: only opted-in open-tier training splits go to assigned miners for z3-mini; data and trained adapters must be deleted within seven days and cannot be served or redistributed by miners. Outside admission remains closed pending rehearsal. The reward rubric is unchanged by PR218, and no new customer delivery or miner earnings were verified.
